subject: POC trial planning & final readout scheduling - Aurora Health
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — summary and next steps

Thanks for the demo today — great coverage of the latency and cost controls. A couple quick notes from our side and an ask to kick off a short POC: 

Summary of Aurora's top priorities from the call:
- Real-time triage assistant for intake nurses (sub-300ms median latency for short prompts)
- PHI isolation: flow where no PII leaves our VPC during trial
- Cost target: <= $0.0025/token average for evaluation workload

POC ask:
- 2-week trial with our sample traffic (mix of short triage prompts + longer discharge summaries)
- Success criteria: 1) 95th percentile latency < 750ms on test suite; 2) semantic accuracy score >= 0.85 on our eval set; 3) no outbound egress of raw PHI logs during trial
- Owner on our side: Daniel Wu (technical lead)
- Decision process: Exec readout at end of trial with CISO + Head of Clinical Ops for go/no-go

Can we confirm Redwood's timeline for spinning up a private trial (VPC connector) and a short evaluation plan? Also please send the SOW and evaluation template so my team can map success metrics.

Thanks,
Jamie
Director of Clinical Innovation
Aurora Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — summary and next steps

Jamie — thanks for the clear priorities and the success criteria. Really helpful. Confirming Redwood can run the 2-week private trial with the VPC connector and the evaluation plan below. High-level plan + owners: 

Proposed POC plan (Redwood):
- Day 0–2: Contract + VPC connector setup (PM: Marcus Lin)
- Day 3–5: Baseline ingest + warm KV cache, run synthetic lat/throughput tests (Infra: Neha Kapoor)
- Day 6–12: Evaluate with Aurora sample traffic (Tech lead: Marcus Lin, Aurora contact: Daniel Wu)
- Day 13: Final readout prep (shared slide deck + evaluation workbook)
- Day 14: Exec readout (CISO + Head Clinical Ops) — go/no-go decision

Success criteria mapping (as we understand it):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 750ms for the triage prompt distribution
- Accuracy: semantic score >= 0.85 on your annotated eval set (we'll run the eval harness and share scoring)
- Security: VPC connector ensures no egress of raw PHI to Redwood hosted control plane; audit logs available (we will provide sample audit log export)

Attachments: attached a draft SOW (POC_SOW_Aurora_Health_v1.pdf) and an evaluation_plan_aurora.xlsx template for your team to fill in sample prompts and the scoring rubric.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marcus will send the VPC connector checklist and a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff (propose Tue 5/25 or Wed 5/26)
2) Parties sign the POC SOW (attached) — we can accept a purchase order if procurement prefers
3) Daniel to drop the eval dataset and scoring sheet into the worksheet by Day 3 of the trial

Looping in Marcus and Neha — Marcus, can you confirm VPC timeline? Neha, we may need infra standby for Day 3–5.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@aurorahealth.com>, Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — summary and next steps

Thanks — quick infra check from my side:
- VPC connector: We can get the connector set up in 48–72 hours after we get the network allowlist and a test instance (Marcus -> Jamie: I'll send the checklist).
- We will deploy a private inference pool (dedicated) with restricted egress; audit log export will be enabled and we'll provide the first sample export by Day 6.
- For latency testing — please provide the typical prompt length distribution and concurrency profile (single-user vs batch). If you can paste that into the eval sheet I attached, we'll prioritize the prompt shapes to optimize kernels and batching.

Procurement / SOW note: If procurement wants a short PO, we can accept that in place of signature for the POC. Once the trial is complete and Aurora decides to move forward, I'll coordinate the pricing quote and contract steps (we'll aim to have a term sheet ready at the readout).

I'll send the VPC checklist and a calendar invite for the kickoff (tentative: Wed 5/26 10:00am PT).

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — summary and next steps

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the SOW + eval template. A few quick confirmations from Aurora: 
- Kickoff: Wed 5/26 10:00am PT works for our team — we'll have Daniel + one of our network engineers on the call.
- Eval sheet: Daniel will populate the prompt distribution and the annotated eval set by Day 3 of the trial (we'll upload to the sheet you attached).
- Final readout: Exec panel is available the morning of Tue 6/8 for a 45-min readout — that will be our go/no-go decision point (CISO + Head Clinical Ops + Head of Procurement may attend).

Procurement: we'll issue a PO for the POC (procurement@aurorahealth.com) and attach internal sign-off to the PO.

Action items we have noted: 
- Marissa: finalize SOW and share DocuSign link or PO instructions
- Marcus: send VPC connector checklist and calendar invite for kickoff (5/26)
- Daniel: upload eval dataset and prompt distribution by Day 3

We'll see you on 5/26. Thanks all.

— Jamie
Director of Clinical Innovation
Aurora Health
